checkins.note: Captured at seed. Worth noting for context: Rigetti's public roadmap has moved before -- an earlier iteration of this same roadmap targeted 100+ qubits with 99.5% median two-qubit fidelity specifically "by the end of 2025," reported the same week -- so the 2025 leg of this claim is the nearest-term thing to watch first.
checkins.author: desk

sourcing_note: No individual executive quote was found attached to these specific year-by-year figures -- they are Rigetti's own reported roadmap targets rather than a spoken quotation, the same shape of sourcing already used for the IBM Starling entry. Rigetti.com itself was not directly fetchable during capture; the figures are corroborated by an independent trade publication's direct reporting on the Q3 2025 earnings call.
verbatim: 2025 Target: delivery of a 100+ qubit chiplet-based quantum system. 2026 Target: deployment of a 150+ qubit system. 2027 Target: deployment of a 1,000+ qubit system.
headline: Rigetti's own roadmap commits to a 100+ qubit chiplet system in 2025, 150+ qubits in 2026, and 1,000+ qubits in 2027.
source_kind: Q3 2025 earnings report / roadmap update, reported
resolution_criteria: Resolves VERIFIED if Rigetti has, by 31 Dec 2027 (plus grace), shipped or operated a system matching each named year's qubit-count target within that year -- checked against Rigetti's own quarterly technical updates and independent reporting, not press-release qubit counts alone (this project's own recurring lesson: a qubit count without connectivity/fidelity context is close to meaningless -- see race.html). PARTIALLY_VERIFIED if the 2025/2026 interim targets slip but the 2027 endpoint is still substantially met. NOT_VERIFIED if the 2027 target is missed outright.
